caveats: No per-cell MHWs (>=5 consecutive hot days at/above the smoothed 90th-percentile threshold) were detected in any of the 3293 sea cells during 2017-06-01 to 2017-08-31; the longest run of hot days was 4. The zero-event result is robust to the percentile interpolation variant (both numpy 'hazen' and 'linear' give the same outcome).
